abilities.effect: Creatures within 10 feet of the cave entrance take 4d10+18 damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save).
abilities.name: Deadfall
abilities.trigger: A creature enters the area without taking care to avoid the hidden trigger plate

hazard.description: A weight-sensitive plate buried underneath sand pulls a boulder over a cliff ledge, causing it to fall on targets within the entrance.
hazard.disable: DC 27 Crafting (expert) or DC 25 Thievery (expert) to find and disconnect the plate from the tipping mechanism
hazard.name: Boulder Deadfall Trap
hazard.reset: Resetting the boulders in the trap is a labor-intensive project that takes 2 hours.

traits.name: Uncommon
traits.text: Something of uncommon rarity requires special training or comes from a particular culture or part of the world. Some character choices give access to uncommon options, and the GM can choose to allow access for anyone. Less is known about uncommon creatures than common creatures. They typically can't be summoned. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to these creature is increased by 2.

traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.
